name: Crypto stress
summary: Bitcoin near $74,300 on 9 Nov, 14% off its high; Binance resumed withdrawals by 1 Nov after a $6.3bn breach
state: Bitcoin was near $74,300 early on 9 Nov, 14.2% below its 52-week high and 7.6% lower on the week, inside the 25% Watch line (Yahoo Finance). Binance resumed withdrawals on 1 Nov after a $6.3bn breach late in October (TechCrunch), and the FBI has attributed the theft to North Korea (NBC News). Searches on 9 Nov found no stablecoin de-peg or new exchange halt, so Normal is kept while watching for any lasting effect on Binance.
for_you: Crypto holdings are largely outside deposit protection schemes, and exchange security failures can interrupt access to funds, as the Binance withdrawal pause showed.
rubric_hit: BTC drawdown 14.2% < 25%; Binance withdrawals resumed 1 Nov and no exchange or stablecoin failure found: Normal

sources.title: TechCrunch — Binance resumes withdrawals following $6.3 billion breach
NBC News — FBI says North Korea was behind the $6.3 billion Binance crypto hack

why: Crypto is now plumbed into mainstream finance via ETFs and stablecoins; a crash or de-peg can spill into funding markets.
drivers: Liquidity, leverage, regulation, stablecoin reserves, exchange solvency.

rubric.alert: Drawdown > 45%, or a major stablecoin de-pegs (> 3% for > 24h), or a top-10 exchange fails.
rubric.watch: Drawdown 25–45%, or a top-10 exchange/stablecoin under stress.
rubric.normal: Bitcoin drawdown from 52-week high < 25% and no major stablecoin/exchange incidents.
